$comment: THE WELCOME EMAIL'S COPY. THE SHORT FOUNDER NOTE WITH THE CAFE PHOTO, 2026-11-19.
This replaces the long 2026-09-18 letter about Beli. It is assembled from the founder's own
approved words and nothing else, except the closing line, which the founder asked for. The
source of every line is in `$sources`. Do not rewrite, reorganise or 'improve' it.
After any edit run `node emails/welcome/build.mjs` and `node --test emails/welcome/email.test.mjs`,
and update LOCKED_LETTER in email.test.mjs in the same commit.
A paragraph is a string, or an array of pieces: a string is text, `{ "bold": ... }` is
emphasis the copy asks for (this letter asks for none), and `{ "link": ..., "target": ... }`
is an inline link to a destination in targets.json. `{{firstName}}` and the invite token
are filled per recipient at send time.
$sources: Greeting, 'Thanks for giving bingd a shot!', the reply paragraph, the invite sentence and 'Happy binging, / Suraj': the founder's 2026-09-18 letter, verbatim.

The Beli paragraph, the 'I built bingd' paragraph and 'Hope you enjoy it as much as I do.': the founder note on bingd.app ('A note from me', web/build.mjs founder-section), verbatim; the same words the founder approved for Instagram Story 04 (v5, 2026-11-10).

'The movie nerd who made bingd.': the founder's requested closing line for this note, 2026-11-19. Replaced 2026-11-20 by the founder's own wording, '(the movie nerd that made bingd)', set on the same line as 'Suraj' in the same font and colour, a little smaller.
The photo: founder-cafe-tea-square.jpg from the founder's Drive folder, resized to 1120px and stripped of all metadata. Alt text drafted for this email.
2026-11-20 (founder, after reading the test in Gmail): the masthead is the real bingd. logo, not the text wordmark, and the 560px photo under the masthead is gone.

The logo: bingd-logo.png is the app's BrandLockup (assets/brand/bingd-icon.svg, the filmstrip mark at 42x25, an 8px gap, and 'bingd.' in DM Serif Display 28px, Maroon), rasterised at 3x on a Paper ground with rounded corners, so Gmail's forced dark mode cannot put Maroon on near-black. Nothing about the logo was redrawn.
Later the same day the founder dropped the photo altogether: a reply-to-me note reads as a personal email without it. founder-cafe-tea.jpg stays published, because every email already sent loads it.

paragraphs: Thanks for giving bingd a shot!
Beli changed the way I experienced restaurants. I went from eating out occasionally to ranking every place, comparing lists with friends, and hunting for the next spot.
I built bingd because I wanted that same post-watch ritual for movies and TV: rank what you watch, compare taste with friends, and keep the fun going after the credits roll.
If you have feature suggestions, something in the app is confusing, or you just want to say hi, reply to this email. It comes straight to me.

. And if you want to see what I'm watching,
Hope you enjoy it as much as I do.
letter.$closingComment: Follows the last sign-off line on the same line, in the same serif and colour, a little smaller (founder, 2026-11-20).

$footerComment: Not part of the letter. The note asks the reader to invite somebody, so it is treated as
commercial email and carries a sender, a physical mailing address and an unsubscribe.
The physical mailing address is NOT here and must never be added here: it is the
operator's home address, and a value committed to this file is in git history for
ever. It is supplied at send time from the WELCOME_POSTAL_ADDRESS environment
variable (the GitHub Actions secret of that name), HTML-escaped as it is filled in.
